description: Cookie Security Audit — Audit the cookies a website sets. Fetches the URL (following up to 5 redirects) and parses every Set-Cookie header: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, Domain scope, __Host-/__Secure- prefix rules, lifetime (400-day browser cap), size, and category (session/auth, analytics, marketing, bot-management). Returns per-cookie findings with severity, a 0-100 score, A-F grade and OK/REVIEW/FIX verdict. Cookie values are never returned. Param: url. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cookie_check
